notes: LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. OneEthCap uses the policy-resolved $owner as its immutable, nonzero beneficiary. It accepts positive native ETH deposits through receive() or deposit(), up to 1 ETH cumulatively over its lifetime. Deposits exceeding the remaining capacity revert in full. Anyone may call sweep() to send the entire ETH balance to the beneficiary; sweeping does not restore deposit capacity, and a beneficiary that rejects ETH causes the sweep to revert. Unknown calldata and token receiver hooks revert. Unsolicited ERC-20 transfers cannot be refused and have no recovery path. Forced ETH bypasses deposit accounting and can make the balance exceed 1 ETH; it is included in sweeps. No initialization calls are required. The factory supplies liquidity, MerkleDistributor and the initialization-only pool guard.
